Internal Review System

Workflow system for reviewing apps before marketplace listing

2022 · Internal tools·CMS

The problem

Wix App Market's internal review platform is the tool Account Managers use to evaluate and approve apps before they go live.

When I joined the project, the team had stopped using it and the process was not platformized. Review work happened in personal Google Docs, which meant no shared history, no visibility into what changed between submissions, and no consistent way to hand off between reviewers. That wasn't sustainable and the volume of app submissions was only increasing.

Research

Conducted discovery research to identify why Account Managers were doing review work in external tools instead of the platform. Pain points pointed to the UI, difficulties in writing a consistent review, the information architecture, and the lack of an integrated workflow

Deciding on the product areas

Before designing the screens, I mapped the product into four areas to define scope and structure.

  1. App directory
  2. App page with activity page and development team page
  3. The review workspace - this was entirely new
  4. Account managers team management

Redesigning the platform

  • Designed a whole new integrated review workflow: in-platform commenting, path-linked issues, clear view of past reports and submission
  • Updated the UI to Wix Style React guidelines and restructured the information architecture for scale
  • Added new features to the App page and App directory (more filters, useful links, additional information per app such as its revenue share and more)
  • Added a new App Market listing status to apps - Listed, Never Listed and Removed
  • Two decisions worth noting: when to auto-start a review (we landed on both an explicit button and triggering on the first comment), and how to show diffs between submissions (a before/after column, no new pattern to learn).

Delivery

  • Ran weekly syncs with the Account Management team to align on scope and surface edge cases early
  • Facilitated a bug hunt session with Account Managers before launch to validate the redesign and surface edge cases

Impact

The tool is still actively used by Wix's Developer Relations team. It reduced account manager workload, shortened the review cycle, and made app evaluations faster and more consistent across the team.

Bottom line

The most telling signal was that the team had already voted with their feet, doing the actual work outside the platform.

That meant success was not about launching a redesign; it was about building something good enough that they would stop reaching for Google Docs. The pre-launch bug hunt session was one of the more useful things I did on this project.
